runtime_comparison.method: Read the surgical git diff and compare whitespace-normalized original top-level computation/data command bodies against the working tree. Ignore only the private-to-public visibility change on TLProgram.axisSpecs.
runtime_comparison.assignUIDs: The equality theorem's inline computation exactly matches the base assignUIDs body modulo whitespace. assignUIDs_eq_inline quantifies over arbitrary programs and equates the entire FreshM function, including error results and final state, not just successful output.
runtime_comparison.unchanged: All original Traverse, Adapter and Admission computation/data command bodies match. Adapter has 379 insertions and zero deletions; Admission has 225 insertions and zero deletions. Added definitions there describe propositions, not replacement checkers.
runtime_comparison.public_surface: TLProgram.axisSpecs is newly public with unchanged collector body; sourceUIDRelabel is a newly public extraction of the original name-based relabel. Existing axisNames and mapUID bodies are unchanged.
runtime_comparison.consequence: No changed acceptance, rejection ordering, diagnostic payload, f32 default, input validation, traversal ordering, or UID/name/kind behavior found.

legend.required: Must emit/classify/preserve the stated supported behavior when the other existing checks succeed.
legend.forbidden: Existing production seam rejects this class; no new rejection guard is requested.
legend.silently_ignored: This seam intentionally skips the class or ignores this metadata. It may still be rejected by another seam.

rows.name: Pinned axis, nat or real kind, including extent zero
rows.required: checkAxes emits (a.uid,n) in original declaration order; PinnedAxisDeclaration and RawPinnedAxisDeclaration preserve the pin.
rows.forbidden: Duplicate axis UID at the adapter seam.
rows.silently_ignored: tensorDecl skips every axis declaration; axis kind and name do not add adapter guards.

rows.name: Unpinned axis
rows.required: Existing missingDomain error, after the duplicate-UID check.
rows.forbidden: Successful checkAxes/AxisDeclarations containing an unpinned axis.
rows.silently_ignored: tensorDecl alone skips it; the preceding axis pass rejects it.

rows.name: Iteration declaration
rows.required: Existing unsupported iteration diagnostic.
rows.forbidden: Both axis selection and tensor selection.
rows.silently_ignored: None in these admission seams.

rows.name: Untyped tensor
rows.required: SupportedTensorDeclaration and tensorDecl agree on original name, ordered slots and f32 default.
rows.forbidden: Duplicate tensor name, unbound declaration slots, missing/incorrect spec, as before.
rows.silently_ignored: checkAxes emits no axis for it.

rows.name: Typed tensor siblings
rows.required: Retain explicit element type, original name and ordered slots.
rows.forbidden: No additional nat/real-kind or declaration/read-UID identity constraint.
rows.silently_ignored: checkAxes emits no axis for it.

rows.name: Untyped linear bias and nonbias siblings
rows.required: Both classify exactly like untyped tensor, with f32 default.
rows.forbidden: No new linear-specific guard.
rows.silently_ignored: Bias bit is immaterial to tensorDecl and SupportedTensorDeclaration; checkAxes skips the declaration.

rows.name: Typed linear type x bias siblings
rows.required: All four cases retain the explicit type, name and ordered slots.
rows.forbidden: No new bias or use-site-kind constraint.
rows.silently_ignored: Bias bit is immaterial; checkAxes skips the declaration.

rows.name: Complex tensor and linear siblings
rows.class: typedTensor / typedLinear complex64 / complex128, both bias bits
rows.required: Existing unsupported complex diagnostic from tensorDecl.
rows.forbidden: SupportedTensorDeclaration is false for all these cases.
rows.silently_ignored: checkAxes alone skips them.

rows.name: Predicate declaration
rows.required: Existing unsupported predicate diagnostic from tensorDecl.
rows.forbidden: TensorDeclarationSelection emission or skip; only axis declarations may skip the table.
rows.silently_ignored: checkAxes skips predicate declarations without emitting an axis.

rows.name: Original declaration locator and signature role
rows.required: TableDeclarations selects decls.zipIdx, records original index rather than compact table position, finds the corresponding spec, preserves spec.role and ordered extent list.
rows.forbidden: Duplicate/missing/unexpected specs and mismatching signature shapes, in existing order.
rows.silently_ignored: Cached DeclEnv and external-name classification do not determine semantic role.

rows.name: Raw same-name binding
rows.class: axis declaration / tensor signature / read / output occurrences
rows.required: Production axisNames traversal and memo relabel bind equal source names to the same UID, retaining name and kind.
rows.forbidden: No added requirement that the initial UIDs or kinds agree.
rows.silently_ignored: Initial UID differences do not choose binding; uncovered or unnamed UData keeps the old fallback behavior.

rows.name: Raw distinct names sharing sentinel zero
rows.class: Different AxisSpec names, all initial UIDs zero
rows.required: Preserve separate name-based minted bindings and occurrence order; no sentinel-UID aliasing.
rows.forbidden: No new nonzero precondition on raw axes.
rows.silently_ignored: Initial zero is a placeholder, not axis identity for raw name resolution.

rows.name: Bare read slots and shape-compatible distinct axes
rows.required: UID must resolve in context; slot extent and rank must match. Ordered/repeated IDs are preserved. Same-extent distinct read-axis UIDs remain accepted even when different from declaration-slot UIDs.
rows.forbidden: Unbound UID or wrong extent/rank, not mere declaration/read UID inequality.
rows.silently_ignored: sourceAxis does not consult AxisSpec.name or kind; there is no new read-role restriction.

rows.name: Nonbare read-slot siblings
rows.required: Existing unsupported affine diagnostic with original slot provenance.
rows.forbidden: BareReadSlots and RawReadSlots classification.
rows.silently_ignored: None at the read-slot seam.

rows.name: Bare output slots
rows.class: LHSSlot.free, including repeated or empty slot lists
rows.required: Preserve ordered indices and destination provenance; repeated UIDs remain duplicated in slots while outputContext retains first-occurrence support.
rows.forbidden: Unbound UID or wrong extent/rank, not repeated slots or use-site kind.
rows.silently_ignored: AxisSpec.name/kind is not an extra post-resolution acceptance check.

rows.name: Nonbare output-slot siblings
rows.required: Existing marked / scanSlot / affine diagnostic respectively.
rows.forbidden: BareOutputSlots and RawOutputSlots classification.
rows.silently_ignored: None at the output-slot seam.

rows.name: Read factor vs other factor siblings
rows.required: read looks up its exact original tensor name, retains original declaration and term/factor/slot provenance; ordered duplicate reads remain distinct occurrences.
rows.forbidden: iverson and unaryFn retain their existing unsupported diagnostics.
rows.silently_ignored: No input-only role restriction on reads, and no deduplication of factors.

rows.name: Writable output-role siblings
rows.required: output and defined remain writable, using exact LHS name lookup.
rows.forbidden: Writing an input retains the existing role diagnostic.
rows.silently_ignored: External name classification does not override explicit spec role.

rows.name: Assignment aggregation/nonlinearity and statement siblings
rows.required: assign checks sum first, identity second, then destination lookup, role, output slots and ordered terms/factors.
rows.forbidden: nonSum, nonIdentity, scatter and recurMorphism remain unsupported.
rows.silently_ignored: An earlier failing check prevents later diagnostics, deliberately.

rows.name: Empty and duplicate/multiplicity cases
rows.class: zero extent / scalar / empty product / empty sum / repeated statements, terms, factors and slots
rows.required: Zero pins and zero-length buffers are accepted; scalars use empty slots; empty product/sum and ordered multiplicities are retained. Duplicate tensor declarations and duplicate axis identities are still errors, distinct from repeated uses.
rows.forbidden: No new positive-size, nonempty, unique-use or one-write-only guard.
rows.silently_ignored: Support deduplication does not deduplicate source occurrences.

rows.name: Input binding siblings
rows.class: input role / noninput role / unused input / zero-size input
rows.required: Every input, even unused or zero-size, requires exactly the existing binding checks: original declaration ID, ordered shape, canonical element count and exact values.
rows.forbidden: Duplicate/unexpected bindings, noninput binding roles, missing inputs, shape mismatch and length mismatch retain their existing diagnostics and ordering.
rows.silently_ignored: Noninput entries need no input buffer; input values are not changed or coerced by these proof additions.

case_class_audit.relation_boundary: These new relations are success certificates, not independent acceptance checkers or biconditional validators. For example, PinnedAxisDeclaration records exact pin selection but does not itself restate duplicate-axis rejection; production success and Context provide that constraint. The supported tensor declaration forms themselves agree exactly with tensorDecl.

required_test_pins.case: Original declaration index, not table position
required_test_pins.evidence: Structural.DeclarationIdentity records both columns for interleaved entries, notably B at table index 1/original declaration 5. interleaved_tensor specializes the certificate to that exact entry. Read/output views also pin original declaration provenance.

The two legal A declarations have [(1,2),(2,2)] versus [(2,2),(1,2)], not merely [2,2]. Both share read slots [2,1]; sameExtentIdentity accepts declaration [i,i] with distinct-axis read slots. No identity-rejection guard was introduced.

AsymmetricOrder pins B,A,B and a second A term, including each name, original declaration, slots and factor origin. IndexedOccurrences repeats the statement at original index 3 and adds a named Diagonal read. FactorFields/RawCheckedFactorFields also relate exact original names to the table entry.
OutputTargetNames changes only the LHS name between writable same-shape Y and Z, and pins table positions 2/5, original declarations 6/9, names, role, axes and full origin.

required_test_pins.case: Diagnostic order with multiple simultaneous violations
required_test_pins.evidence: refusal simultaneously has max, relu and Missing output. ExactErrorOrder pins nonSum, then nonIdentity after changing only aggregation, then undeclaredTensor Missing after changing only nonlinearity, including stage and every SourceOrigin field. Changing only output name finally yields admission success.

required_test_pins.case: Sentinel names vs same-name mismatched initial UIDs
required_test_pins.evidence: RawSentinelNames uses distinct a/b names sharing initial UID zero and reverses legal read slots. ResolverMetadataFidelity separately uses same name a at initial UIDs 17,29,43,81,19 with mixed nat/real kinds; full resolved decl/statement equality retains kinds and maps every UID to 1. distinctZero supplies another sentinel neighbor.

DeclarationForms exercises nine actual raw-admission cases: untyped tensor, typed f32/f64 tensors, untyped linear bias/nonbias, and typed f32/f64 linear bias/nonbias; exact entries and ordered duplicate read occurrences are guarded. Existing acceptance tests also reject both complex types across tensor/linear and both linear bias bits.

required_test_pins.case: Zero, empty, duplicate and multiplicity behavior
required_test_pins.evidence: New guards pin zero extents, repeated declaration/output slots, empty product and sum, duplicate reads/terms and repeated statements without deduplication. Existing registered tests pin scalar slots, zero/unused input requirements, and distinguish repeated uses from duplicate axis/tensor declarations.

Preserve that chronology and reconcile it explicitly in the final plan/package rather than presenting the historical snapshots as current cycle totals.
